budget_contract.parity_filler: declared inert digit-unit filler inside validated payload, hash-covered

kill_condition: The conjunction fails: typed does not beat flat or vector (paired bootstrap LCB <= 0), removal or shuffle retains the effect, any item exceeds the 512 spread, or any arm makes other than exactly 3 calls. On rejection, the current 3-function belt composition claim stops (canon direction 2026-07-24 line: typed=vector tie twice means role-decomposition/state-representation replacement, not belt patching).
honesty_boundaries: n=100 sealed slice of 2Wiki validation only; no production or cross-dataset generalization.
Bootstrap CIs are over the fixed sealed panel, not a population claim.
A PASS activates the ORDERED sequence (Gate-0 registration then P1v5); it is not itself an efficacy claim beyond the F1 question.
Development runs (r1-r5) are engineering receipts only and carry no sealed weight.
